description: Machine-readable inventory of the deliberate accessibility problems in the original Record a goose sighting exercise. It is deliberately separate from the ACT fixture manifest: most of these problems do not map to an approved ACT rule.

counts.note: The answer key says 19 issues but enumerates 18. Commit 66a64cb removed the role=button answer when that attribute was added, without updating the total. The live page now reads '19 issues in total (likely 18)'. This inventory records the 18 described items and does not invent a nineteenth.

evidence.assertion: The page contains two h1 elements; the second is the related-links heading.

issues.title: Related links appear in a different order to the DOM

evidence.assertion: CSS order values are 1, 3, 2 while the DOM and Tab order are Wikipedia, More, RSPB.
evidence.test: tests/accessibility-regression.spec.js: keeps the related links in a different visual order to the DOM

issues.title: External link opens a new tab without warning

evidence.assertion: The RSPB link has target=_blank and its accessible name gives no advance warning.
evidence.test: tests/accessibility-regression.spec.js: keeps an external link that opens a new tab without warning

evidence.assertion: The link's accessible name is exactly 'More' and only makes sense from the surrounding section.
evidence.test: tests/accessibility-regression.spec.js: keeps the ambiguous "More" link text

issues.title: Related links lose their focus indicator

evidence.assertion: Focused a.link elements have outline:none and a transparent background.
evidence.test: tests/accessibility-regression.spec.js: keeps the invisible focus indicator on the related links
tests/accessibility-regression.spec.js: keeps the empty page title

evidence.assertion: The fieldset contains no legend and the question sits outside it.
evidence.test: tests/accessibility-regression.spec.js: keeps the empty radio group legend

issues.title: Continue button removed from sequential focus

evidence.assertion: The submit button has tabindex=-1 and is never reached by Tab.
evidence.test: tests/accessibility-regression.spec.js: keeps the Continue button out of sequential keyboard focus

evidence.assertion: Hint colour is rgb(157, 157, 161) on white; contrast is below 4.5:1.
evidence.test: tests/accessibility-regression.spec.js: keeps the low-contrast hint text

issues.title: Page title is 'Boop - Record a goose sighting'

evidence.assertion: The title contains 'Boop' and does not describe the page question.
The visually hidden paragraph has tabindex=0 and is the second Tab stop.
evidence.test: tests/accessibility-regression.spec.js: keeps the focusable, visually hidden ghost goose

issues.title: Formatting hint only available as placeholder text

evidence.assertion: The input has a placeholder and no persistent hint or aria-describedby.
evidence.test: tests/accessibility-regression.spec.js: keeps the placeholder as the only formatting instruction

issues.title: Change links use incorrect visually hidden text

evidence.assertion: Visually hidden text reads 'biscuits' and 'cake' instead of the field being changed.
evidence.test: tests/accessibility-regression.spec.js: keeps the incorrect visually hidden Change-link text

issues.title: Heading level jumps from h1 to h3

evidence.assertion: The first two heading levels are 1 then 3.
evidence.test: tests/accessibility-regression.spec.js: keeps the incorrect heading hierarchy

evidence.assertion: The confirmation heading is literally 'GOOSE RECORDED'.
evidence.test: tests/accessibility-regression.spec.js: keeps the uppercase confirmation heading

evidence.assertion: The paragraph computes to text-align: justify.

issues.title: Animated GIF has no alternative text

evidence.assertion: The confirmation image has no alt attribute and axe reports image-alt.
evidence.test: tests/accessibility-regression.spec.js: keeps the animated GIF without alternative text

issues.title: Animation cannot be paused or stopped

evidence.assertion: The looping GIF has no pause, stop or hide control.
